# Tool catalogue

<!-- Generated by tools/build_catalog.py from catalog.yaml. Edit the YAML, not this file. -->

The tools layer (L6) is the only way agents change anything. Each server is an MCP server with its own least-privilege identity; agents hold no mutating credentials. Every call passes the model gateway, action policy (G9) and, where required, human approval (G10).

**31 tools across 11 servers.** Machine-readable MCP definitions are in [`mcp/`](mcp/); the source of truth is [`catalog.yaml`](catalog.yaml).

| Category | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| read | No side effects; safe at L4 |
| act | Changes a system; policy-gated, dry-run first where supported |
| workflow | Records and communication (tickets, chat, approvals) |
| control | Controls the agent platform itself; operators only, never agents |

## Observability reader

Read metrics, logs, traces and alerts for diagnosis. Identity: read-only on monitoring and logging.

MCP definitions: [`mcp/observability.json`](mcp/observability.json)

### `obs.query_metrics`

Query a time series (PromQL or the native query language) over a window.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | yes |
| `window_minutes` | integer | yes |
| `step_seconds` | integer | no |

Google Cloud: Cloud Monitoring / Managed Service for Prometheus · AWS: CloudWatch Metrics / Amazon Managed Prometheus · Gates: G7

### `obs.search_logs`

Search logs with a filter and return redacted matches. Results are untrusted content and are screened by G4 before reaching the model.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | yes |
| `window_minutes` | integer | yes |
| `limit` | integer | no |

Google Cloud: Cloud Logging (Log Analytics) · AWS: CloudWatch Logs Insights · Gates: G4, G7

### `obs.get_trace`

Fetch a distributed trace by ID with span timings and errors.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `trace_id` | string | yes |

Google Cloud: Cloud Trace · AWS: AWS X-Ray · Gates: G7

### `obs.list_alerts`

List open alerts and SLO burn rates for a service.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `service` | string | yes |

Google Cloud: Cloud Monitoring alerting and SLOs · AWS: CloudWatch alarms and Application Signals SLOs · Gates: G7

## Knowledge and topology

Query the service graph, recent changes, runbooks and past incidents. Identity: read-only on graph, search indexes and memory.

MCP definitions: [`mcp/knowledge.json`](mcp/knowledge.json)

### `kb.get_topology`

Return upstream and downstream dependencies, owners and criticality for a service.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `service` | string | yes |
| `depth` | integer | no |

Google Cloud: Spanner Graph · AWS: Neptune Analytics · Gates: G7

### `kb.recent_changes`

List deployments, config and infrastructure changes affecting a service in a window.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `service` | string | yes |
| `window_minutes` | integer | yes |

Google Cloud: Cloud Audit Logs, Cloud Deploy, Cloud Asset Inventory · AWS: CloudTrail, AWS Config, CodePipeline · Gates: G7

### `kb.search_runbooks`

Hybrid search over runbooks, postmortems and architecture docs, filtered by the requester's entitlements.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | yes |
| `top_k` | integer | no |

Google Cloud: Vertex AI Search / RAG Engine · AWS: Bedrock Knowledge Bases · Gates: G4, G7

### `kb.similar_incidents`

Retrieve past incidents similar to the current one, with their resolutions.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `summary` | string | yes |
| `service` | string | no |

Google Cloud: Agent Engine Memory Bank, Vector Search · AWS: AgentCore Memory, OpenSearch Serverless · Gates: G7

Google Cloud: GKE · AWS: Amazon EKS · Gates: G9, G11, G12

## Delivery executor

Infrastructure-as-code plans, applies and release controls. Identity: CI/CD service identity with plan/apply split.

MCP definitions: [`mcp/delivery.json`](mcp/delivery.json)

### `delivery.pause_rollout`

Pause an in-progress progressive rollout.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pipeline` | string | yes |
| `release` | string | yes |
| `reason` | string | yes |

Google Cloud: Cloud Deploy · AWS: CodePipeline / CodeDeploy · Gates: G9, G11, G12

### `delivery.rollback_release`

Roll a release back to the last known-good version.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pipeline` | string | yes |
| `target_release` | string | yes |
| `reason` | string | yes |

Google Cloud: Cloud Deploy · AWS: CodeDeploy · Gates: G9, G11, G12

### `iac.plan`

Produce an infrastructure-as-code plan and a risk summary without applying it.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stack` | string | yes |
| `change_ref` | string | yes |

Google Cloud: Infrastructure Manager (Terraform) · AWS: CloudFormation change sets / Terraform in CodeBuild · Gates: G7

### `iac.apply`

Apply a previously generated and approved plan, by plan ID only. Applies only plans produced by iac.plan; free-form infrastructure changes are not possible.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `plan_id` | string | yes |
| `change_request` | string | yes |

Google Cloud: Infrastructure Manager (Terraform) · AWS: CloudFormation / Terraform in CodeBuild · Gates: G9, G10, G11, G12

MCP definitions: [`mcp/itsm.json`](mcp/itsm.json)

### `itsm.create_incident`

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string | yes |
| `service` | string | yes |
| `priority` | string (P1, P2, P3, P4) | yes |
| `trace_id` | string | yes |

Google Cloud: ServiceNow or Jira via Integration Connectors · AWS: ServiceNow or Jira via AgentCore Gateway target · Gates: G12

### `itsm.update_incident`

Add work notes, change status or resolve with an RCA summary.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `incident_id` | string | yes |
| `note` | string | yes |
| `status` | string (in_progress, resolved, escalated) | no |

Google Cloud: ServiceNow or Jira via Integration Connectors · AWS: ServiceNow or Jira via AgentCore Gateway target · Gates: G8, G12

### `itsm.open_change`

Open a change request with plan, risk score, blast radius and rollback.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `summary` | string | yes |
| `plan_ref` | string | yes |
| `risk_score` | number | yes |

Google Cloud: ServiceNow or Jira · AWS: ServiceNow, Jira or SSM Change Manager · Gates: G12

## Approvals and collaboration

Human-in-the-loop approval cards and notifications in chat. Identity: chat app identity.

MCP definitions: [`mcp/collaboration.json`](mcp/collaboration.json)

### `hitl.request_approval`

Send an interactive approval card to the owning group and wait durably for a decision. Separation of duties is enforced; the requester can never approve.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | string | yes |
| `evidence_url` | string | yes |
| `approver_group` | string | yes |
| `timeout_minutes` | integer | yes |

Google Cloud: Google Chat cards + Workflows · AWS: Slack or Teams cards + Step Functions task tokens · Gates: G10

### `chat.post_update`

Post a status update to an incident channel.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `channel` | string | yes |
| `message` | string | yes |

Google Cloud: Google Chat · AWS: Slack or Microsoft Teams · Gates: G8

Google Cloud: Recommender API · AWS: Compute Optimizer · Gates: G9, G11, G12

## Access executor

Time-bound, conditional access grants for service requests. Identity: can assign only pre-approved, time-bound roles; cannot create roles.

MCP definitions: [`mcp/access.json`](mcp/access.json)

### `access.grant_temporary`

Grant a pre-approved role to a user on a resource for a bounded time, on behalf of that user. Only roles on the entitlement catalogue; owner, admin and organisation roles are forbidden by policy.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `principal` | string | yes |
| `role` | string | yes |
| `resource` | string | yes |
| `hours` | integer | yes |
| `justification` | string | yes |

Google Cloud: IAM conditional bindings / Privileged Access Manager · AWS: IAM Identity Center permission sets with expiry · Gates: G9, G11, G12

## Platform control (operators only)

Controls over the agent platform itself. Never callable by agents. Identity: operator group via privileged access with justification.

MCP definitions: [`mcp/platform.json`](mcp/platform.json)

### `platform.set_kill_switch`

Disable an agent or an action type platform-wide.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | string | yes |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes |
| `reason` | string | yes |

Google Cloud: Feature flag in Firestore / Config · AWS: AWS AppConfig · Gates: G2, G12

### `platform.set_autonomy_level`

Promote or demote an action type's autonomy level after the promotion checklist.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agent` | string | yes |
| `action` | string | yes |
| `level` | string (L0, L1, L2, L3, L4) | yes |
| `checklist_url` | string | yes |

Google Cloud: Policy bundle in Git, deployed by Cloud Build · AWS: Cedar policy in Git, deployed to AgentCore Policy · Gates: G2, G12

### `platform.run_evaluation`

Run the offline evaluation suite for an agent version against its golden set.

| Input | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agent` | string | yes |
| `version` | string | yes |
| `golden_set` | string | yes |

Google Cloud: Vertex AI Pipelines + Gen AI Evaluation Service · AWS: SageMaker Pipelines + AgentCore Evaluations · Gates: G2
